cohort: The study included 220 Jordanian women over 18 years old who had undergone a hysterectomy and received care at government hospitals in Amman.
finding: Depression was highly prevalent among Jordanian women who underwent hysterectomy, with approximately half reporting depressive symptoms, and was significantly predicted by age, sexuality change, and number of children.
cross-section timing: After hysterectomy, with no specific time window mentioned.
